agent.name: PharosGuard
agent.description: Security intelligence for Pharos and EVM wallets. PharosGuard scans one public 0x address and returns a clear risk score, risk level, behavioral metrics, flags, and JSON summary. It never asks for private keys, seed phrases, signatures, or personal data.

services.serviceDescription:
Summary: Analyzes one public Pharos/EVM wallet or contract address and returns risk score, risk level, behavior metrics, flags, and a concise security summary.
Input requirements: Provide exactly one 42-character 0x EVM address. Do not provide private keys, seed phrases, signatures, passwords, API keys, or personal data.
Output: JSON with wallet_address, risk_score, risk_level, data_source, metrics, risk_components, flags, and summary.
Payment: This paid A2MCP endpoint is gated with OKX Agent Payments Protocol. Unpaid calls receive HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge; paid retries use PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

wallet_address.description: A single public EVM wallet or contract address. Example: 0x33aD3000126D3257110fa8B4Db038059cF684614

verified_endpoint_test.note: After PHAROSGUARD_OKX_PAYMENTS_ENABLED=true, unauthenticated requests should return 402; successful paid retries with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE return the wallet-risk JSON.

invalid_input_test.expected_behavior: Rejects invalid wallet input with JSON error; does not process secrets or personal data.

review_evidence.redirect_note: Use the www endpoint. The bare domain redirects to www, so www avoids reviewer/client redirect issues.

safety_notes: Never request private keys, seed phrases, signatures, passwords, API keys, or personal data.
Endpoint accepts one wallet_address value and rejects invalid non-0x inputs.
A2MCP is preferred because this is a deterministic API/tool call, not a multi-turn A2A task.
blocked_until: User explicitly approves any new onchain ASP creation or replacement listing.
OnchainOS wallet login succeeds in the active session.
ASP avatar is uploaded if the registration flow requires a hosted avatar URL.
deployment_notes: Set PHAROSGUARD_OKX_PAYMENTS_ENABLED=true on the production A2MCP service before OKX.AI resubmission.
Set PHAROSGUARD_OKX_PAYMENT_RECEIVER to the receiving wallet and keep secrets out of repository files.
Optional overrides: PHAROSGUARD_OKX_PAYMENT_AMOUNT_ATOMIC, PHAROSGUARD_OKX_PAYMENT_NETWORK, PHAROSGUARD_OKX_PAYMENT_ASSET, PHAROSGUARD_OKX_PAYMENT_CURRENCY, PHAROSGUARD_OKX_PAYMENT_DECIMALS.
